name: Ice
notes: Frozen water: frozen ponds, icicles, Frost spell walls. Frozen at −5 °C, below its 0 °C freezing point, so it melts when warmed. Density 917 kg/m³: ice floats. Friction 0.05 is the spec's ice reference. Brittle: a single 40 J impact (a hard thrown rock or a heavy blow) shatters it. Transparent and a skill climb (grade 3). Sounds like glass on impact (tink, shatter); snow-ice footsteps are close to stone (+1 dB).
